item.skyabyss.wild_banner_spear.desc: +1 reach. Under the banner: you and allies within 6 deal +6% damage
item.skyabyss.wild_bonespike_bow.desc: Arrows cause bleeding (30% of the hit over 3s)
item.skyabyss.wild_bonebird_totem.desc: Each hit heals you and allies within 5 by 0.5
item.skyabyss.wild_ramhorn_greatsword.de: Every 4th hit calls lightning (70% to the target and within 2)
item.skyabyss.wild_shipwright_maul.desc: Hits lower the target's armor by 1 (3s, up to -4)
item.skyabyss.wild_conductor_axe.desc: Hits arc lightning to 2 nearby enemies (35%)
item.skyabyss.wild_lure_staff.desc: Hits wrap the target in fog (-15% damage dealt, 3s)
item.skyabyss.wild_fluff_staff.desc: Hits charge the target; lightning strikes 2s later (50%)
item.skyabyss.wild_hermit_knife.desc: +40% on the first hit against a full-health target
item.skyabyss.wild_fogbell_bell_staff.de: Hits mark the target for 4s (+8% damage from everyone)
item.skyabyss.wild_loom_bell_staff.desc: Hits grant allies within 6 +10% speed and +8% damage for 4s
item.skyabyss.wild_gale_glaive.desc: +1 reach; the strike carries on to a second enemy behind (60%)
item.skyabyss.wild_fortress_greatsword.d: Last stand: +25% damage below half health
item.skyabyss.wild_lavajaw_greatsword.de: Always: -20% fire damage taken. Every 3rd hit the jaw snaps shut (extra 60% and burning for 4s)
item.skyabyss.wild_snowsplitter_axe.desc: Hits chill (Slowness I); every 3rd freezes (Slowness III, 1s)
item.skyabyss.wild_bellows_hammer.desc: Hits build heat (max 5); at 5 the next hit bursts (100% within 3)
item.skyabyss.wild_ashrite_maul.desc: Always: kills give 3 absorption (8s). Every 6th hit rains ash (80% within 4, blinds 2s)
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudreader_staff.des: +20% damage in rain or storm; +10% mana regeneration in clear weather
item.skyabyss.wild_emberbug_staff.desc: Each hit releases an emberbug that bursts on the nearest enemy after 2s (40%, burning)
item.skyabyss.wild_warden_crown_staff.de: Always: +20% mana regeneration. Hits have a 25% chance to drop 3 thunder feathers (50% each within 2.5)
item.skyabyss.wild_windcutter_bow.desc: Arrows ricochet once to a nearby enemy (50%)
item.skyabyss.wild_ashhook_bow.desc: Arrows drag the target 2 blocks toward you and slow it for 1.5s
item.skyabyss.wild_crater_longbow.desc: Always: -20% fire damage taken. Fully drawn arrows explode on impact (60% within 2.5, burning)
item.skyabyss.wild_cinder_claw.desc: +5% per consecutive hit on the same target (max +30%)
item.skyabyss.wild_venom_fang.desc: Always: +25% from behind. Backstabs inject ash venom (120% of attack over 4s)
item.skyabyss.wild_peak_totem.desc: Hits grant allies within 6 -8% damage taken for 3s
item.skyabyss.wild_ashsow_bell_staff.des: 8% of damage dealt heals the most wounded ally within 6
item.skyabyss.wild_stormdrum_totem.desc: Always: allies within 6 deal +5% damage. Every 5th hit beats the drum (enemies within 6 are stunned 1s, allies heal 2)
item.skyabyss.wild_saltcrystal_greatswor: Hits lower the target's armor by 3 (4s)
item.skyabyss.wild_rope_halberd.desc: Once every 6s, a hit drags the target in; your next hit deals +30%
item.skyabyss.wild_inverted_greatsword.d: Always: no fall damage. Falling strikes deal x1.8 and shock enemies within 3 (60%)
item.skyabyss.wild_saltmill_maul.desc: Every 4th hit splits the ground (80% within 3)
item.skyabyss.wild_lampeater_hammer.desc: Always: +15% in darkness. Heals 8% of damage dealt; every 6th hit spews swallowed light (120% in a cone of 5)
item.skyabyss.wild_salttear_staff.desc: Hits root the target for 1.5s (bosses: Slowness II); 6s cooldown
item.skyabyss.wild_mimic_heart_staff.des: Always: +6 max health. Heals 6% of damage; at full health stores heartbeats instead (max 10), and at 10 the next hit deals x2
item.skyabyss.wild_bonestring_bow.desc: Arrows pierce 2 enemies, +15% per enemy pierced
item.skyabyss.wild_lantern_bow.desc: Arrows light the target for 6s (+10% damage from everyone)
item.skyabyss.wild_hanged_longbow.desc: Always: -50% fall damage. Fully drawn arrows hang the target for 1.5s (bosses: Slowness III); +30% against hanged targets
item.skyabyss.wild_bone_needle_dagger.de: Stacks bleeding (max 5; 0.6 per stack each second)
item.skyabyss.wild_snuffer_dagger.desc: Always: enemies notice you at half range. Backstabs deal x1.5 and snuff the target's light (it loses you and slows for 3s; bosses 1s)
item.skyabyss.wild_mourning_bell_staff.d: Hits grant allies within 6 Regeneration I for 5s
item.skyabyss.wild_saltpillar_totem.desc: Hits make the target deal -20% damage (5s)
item.skyabyss.wild_knotted_bell_staff.de: Hits bind the target to a nearby enemy for 5s (each shares 30% of the other's damage)
item.skyabyss.wild_lullaby_bell_staff.de: Always: allies within 8 take -6% damage. Every 8th hit sings a lullaby (enemies within 6 sleep 2s, bosses 0.5s; allies heal 3)
item.skyabyss.wild_fulgurite_sword.desc: Hits have a 12% chance to call lightning (100%)
item.skyabyss.wild_twin_spear.desc: +1 reach. Every 3rd hit also thrusts behind you (100% within 3)
item.skyabyss.wild_meteor_greatsword.des: Always: +6 max health. Each hit grants 1 absorption (max 6, 10s); +10% damage while it holds
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudcleaver_greatswo: Always: +6% movement speed. Each swing sends a wind blade forward (8 blocks, 50% to enemies it passes)
item.skyabyss.wild_molten_axe.desc: Sets targets ablaze (3s); +10% against burning targets
item.skyabyss.wild_cog_hammer.desc: Each consecutive hit adds +5% attack speed (max +25%, resets after 2s)
item.skyabyss.wild_abyss_mace.desc: Hits drag the target 2 blocks in and deal 50% within 2.5
item.skyabyss.wild_starforge_hammer.desc: Always: +3 toughness. Every 4th hit sprays star sparks (100% within 3, burning)
item.skyabyss.wild_skysplit_axe.desc: Always: ignores 30% armor. +20% against targets above half health; kills grant +20% attack speed for 4s
item.skyabyss.wild_ballspark_staff.desc: Hits arc lightning to 3 nearby enemies (30%)
item.skyabyss.wild_hourglass_staff.desc: Hits slow the target (Slowness II, 3s); +15% against slowed targets
item.skyabyss.wild_starchart_staff.desc: Always: +25% mana regeneration. Each hit draws a star; at 5 the constellation strikes (200% within 5)
item.skyabyss.wild_prism_staff.desc: Always: -10% skill cooldowns. Hits cycle the seven colours (burn, chill, lightning, poison, root, heal, mark)
item.skyabyss.wild_flash_bow.desc: Arrows have a 25% chance to call lightning (100%)
item.skyabyss.wild_scope_longbow.desc: Hold a full draw for 1s: the arrow deals +35%
item.skyabyss.wild_calling_bow.desc: Arrows curve toward enemies within 6; +10% damage
item.skyabyss.wild_lighthouse_longbow.de: Hold a full draw for 2s: fires a beam of light (x1.5 to every enemy in a 24-block line)
item.skyabyss.wild_skylark_bow.desc: Always: no fall damage. Arrows loosed in the air split into 3 (70% each) and deal x1.15
item.skyabyss.wild_spark_dagger.desc: 15% chance to stun the target for 0.5s
item.skyabyss.wild_ash_sickle_claw.desc: Each hit adds +4% speed (max +20%); kills grant +30% speed for 3s
item.skyabyss.wild_fishhook_knife.desc: Hits reel the target in; your next hit deals +25%
item.skyabyss.wild_mirror_dagger.desc: Always: reflects 10% of damage taken. Backstabs are repeated by your reflection 0.5s later
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudveil_claw.desc: Always: +8% movement speed. Hits have an 8% chance to vanish you for 1s; your next hit deals x2
item.skyabyss.wild_raincall_bell_staff.d: Hits grant allies within 6 +20% mana regeneration for 4s
item.skyabyss.wild_calming_censer.desc: Each hit leaves incense smoke (3s, radius 3: allies inside take -10% damage, enemies are slowed)
item.skyabyss.wild_effigy_totem.desc: Takes 15% of the damage dealt to allies within 6; you take -20% damage
item.skyabyss.wild_starbell_totem.desc: Always: allies within 8 gain +4 max health. Every 6th hit bursts a star fruit (allies within 6 heal 4 and deal +10% for 6s)
Always: revive fallen allies twice as fast. Hits have a 10% chance to chant (allies within 8 take -25% damage and heal 2/s for 4s)
item.skyabyss.wild_oilskin.desc: Light set. 4 pieces: +5% speed, faster swimming
item.skyabyss.wild_oldsoldier.desc: Heavy set. 2 pieces: +4 max health. 4 pieces: below 30% health gain Resistance II for 3s (60s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_sailcloth.desc: Light set. 4 pieces: +5% speed, longer breath underwater
item.skyabyss.wild_lurelight.desc: Mystic set. 2 pieces: +5 max mana. 4 pieces: at night +25% mana regeneration and +5% damage
item.skyabyss.wild_ramfleece.desc: Heavy set. 2 pieces: +2 toughness. 4 pieces: when hit, 25% chance to strike the attacker with lightning (4)
item.skyabyss.wild_windweave.desc: Light set. 4 pieces: -50% fall damage, +6% speed
item.skyabyss.wild_ashleather.desc: Mystic set. 4 pieces: -25% fire damage taken, +10% against burning targets, +15% mana regeneration
item.skyabyss.wild_fortress.desc: Heavy set. 2 pieces: +3 toughness. 4 pieces, Bulwark: standing still reduces damage taken by 5% per second (max -20%)
item.skyabyss.wild_delver.desc: Light set. 4 pieces: -30% fall damage, +4% speed, night vision in the dark
item.skyabyss.wild_saltplate.desc: Heavy set. 4 pieces: +2 toughness; when hit, 20% chance to stab the attacker with salt (4)
item.skyabyss.wild_lampkeeper.desc: Mystic set. 4 pieces: +25% mana regeneration; you light up your surroundings
item.skyabyss.wild_hanged.desc: Light set. 2 pieces: +5% speed. 4 pieces, Noose: survive a lethal blow at 1 health and leap back (180s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_copperwire.desc: Medium set. 4 pieces: -40% lightning damage taken; when hit, 15% chance to return lightning
item.skyabyss.wild_soot.desc: Light set. 4 pieces: +8% speed; enemies lose track of you while sneaking
item.skyabyss.wild_deepwarden.desc: Heavy set. 4 pieces: -8% damage taken, -16% below half health
item.skyabyss.wild_stargazer.desc: Mystic set. 4 pieces: +35% mana regeneration; +8% damage at night
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudknight.desc: Heavy set. 4 pieces, Cloud Guard: every 20s gain 6 absorption; +10% speed while it holds
item.skyabyss.wild_herb_vial.desc: Charm ([H] to use). Use: heal 6 (45s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_float_netsuke.desc: Trinket. Faster swimming, longer breath, +3% speed
item.skyabyss.wild_crab_backplate.desc: Trinket. +2 toughness; 15% chance to return 3 damage when hit
item.skyabyss.wild_fog_handbell.desc: Charm ([H] to use). Use: enemies within 8 are slowed and blinded by fog for 3s (40s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_emberbug_amber.desc: Trinket. +10% against burning targets, -15% fire damage taken
item.skyabyss.wild_ramhorn_bugle.desc: Trinket. +15% damage below half health, +2 toughness
item.skyabyss.wild_ash_talisman.desc: Charm ([H] to use). Use: clear harmful effects and gain Resistance I for 5s (50s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_signal_fire.desc: Charm ([H] to use). Use: you and allies within 8 deal +15% damage for 8s (60s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_plumb_line_ring.desc: Trinket. -50% fall damage; night vision in the dark
item.skyabyss.wild_hangman_knot.desc: Trinket. Survive a lethal blow at 1 health and leap back (240s cooldown); +4% speed
item.skyabyss.wild_lamp_charm.desc: Charm ([H] to use). Use: light your surroundings for 10s and mark enemies within 10 (+10% damage from everyone) (45s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_mimic_heart_charm.des: Charm ([H] to use). Use: restore 50% of max health (120s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_fulgurite_necklace.de: Trinket. -30% lightning damage taken; 10% chance to return lightning when hit
item.skyabyss.wild_meteor_ring.desc: Trinket. +6 max health, +2 toughness, -5% damage taken (-10% below half health)
item.skyabyss.wild_starchart_compass.des: Charm ([H] to use). Use: blink 8 blocks forward (20s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_moon_hourglass.desc: Charm ([H] to use). Use: freeze enemies within 10 for 3s (bosses 1s) (75s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudhymn_slip.desc: Charm ([H] to use). Use: you and allies within 10 heal 10 and take -20% damage for 8s (90s cooldown)
item.skyabyss.wild_guard_sword.story: "A capital guard rings the bell before drawing the blade."
item.skyabyss.wild_banner_spear.story: "The banner tore; the spearhead never rusted."
item.skyabyss.wild_quarry_hammer.story: "Read the grain of the stone and the mountain splits willingly."
item.skyabyss.wild_tusk_axe.story: "The boar was lord of the hills. Its tusk is the deed."
item.skyabyss.wild_moss_staff.story: "Moss light remembers the paths across the night hills."
item.skyabyss.wild_crow_bow.story: "You chase the crows off. Shooting them comes last."
item.skyabyss.wild_bonespike_bow.story: "Bone is light and supple. Even after death."
item.skyabyss.wild_rat_knife.story: "Rats are small, so the knife can be small too."
"When the clapper rattles, every field hand turns."
item.skyabyss.wild_bonebird_totem.story: "The bone bird never flies. It only carries prayers."
item.skyabyss.wild_oar_blade.story: "The ferryman held the shore with a single oar."
item.skyabyss.wild_dune_sword.story: "Those who dive the dunes dye their blades sand-gold."
item.skyabyss.wild_ramhorn_greatsword.st: "The tighter the horn curls, the more thunder the ram calls."
item.skyabyss.wild_shipwright_maul.story: "A ship floats on mallet blows, not on nails."
item.skyabyss.wild_crab_hammer.story: "The great crab left one claw to the tide."
item.skyabyss.wild_conductor_axe.story: "An axe that catches lightning. Before it lands, it comes here."
item.skyabyss.wild_tidewatch_staff.story: "The staff's shadow tells the tide's rise and fall."
item.skyabyss.wild_lure_staff.story: "Lure-fires call the fish. Sometimes other things too."
item.skyabyss.wild_fluff_staff.story: "The fleece stores lightning. Don't stroke it."
item.skyabyss.wild_gull_bow.story: "Gulls sleep on the wind. So do these arrows."
item.skyabyss.wild_nacre_bow.story: "Waves took a thousand years to lay this nacre."
item.skyabyss.wild_eaglet_longbow.story: "An eaglet never misses its first kill."
item.skyabyss.wild_shore_dagger.story: "On the rocks, the needle is faster than the feet."
item.skyabyss.wild_hermit_knife.story: "The hermit crab keeps its blade hidden too."
item.skyabyss.wild_stormwolf_fang.story: "A stormwolf's fang still crackles after it falls out."
item.skyabyss.wild_shell_bell_staff.stor: "Beach shells remember the songs of the tide."
item.skyabyss.wild_fogbell_bell_staff.st: "On foggy nights this bell is the only road."
item.skyabyss.wild_loom_bell_staff.story: "Even the wind keeps time with the loom."
item.skyabyss.wild_gale_glaive.story: "The wind sings only after the blade has passed."
item.skyabyss.wild_fortress_greatsword.s: "The fort burned. Only its gate became a sword."
item.skyabyss.wild_lavajaw_greatsword.st: "A molten jaw still bites when it cools."
item.skyabyss.wild_snowsplitter_axe.stor: "With this axe, summit snow splits before spring."
item.skyabyss.wild_bellows_hammer.story: "Strike with the bellows' breath and iron wakes."
item.skyabyss.wild_ashrite_maul.story: "The ash folk strike hard, even when burying."
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudreader_staff.sto: "Read the clouds and you know tomorrow's thunder."
item.skyabyss.wild_emberbug_staff.story: "The emberbugs in the cage never want to leave."
item.skyabyss.wild_warden_crown_staff.st: "The warden's crown burned. The oath did not."
item.skyabyss.wild_windcutter_bow.story: "Cut the wind and the arrow arrives ahead of it."
item.skyabyss.wild_crater_longbow.story: "A string strung on a crater's rim never lets go of the heat."
item.skyabyss.wild_frostfang_dagger.stor: "A frost fang turns the wound to winter."
item.skyabyss.wild_cinder_claw.story: "Even cinders make a claw, if there are two."
item.skyabyss.wild_peak_totem.story: "A summit prayer reaches the valley folk too."
item.skyabyss.wild_ashsow_bell_staff.sto: "Ash is sown for the next sprout."
item.skyabyss.wild_stormdrum_totem.story: "Beat the drum thrice and the storm answers."
item.skyabyss.wild_delver_sword.story: "Delvers' swords are long. So is the dark of the shaft."
item.skyabyss.wild_saltcrystal_greatswor: "Salt never rots. What it cuts is another matter."
item.skyabyss.wild_rope_halberd.story: "Throw the rope and even the falling can be hauled back."
item.skyabyss.wild_inverted_greatsword.s: "For those who walk upside down, the sky is underfoot."
item.skyabyss.wild_pick_hammer.story: "When the digging stops, climb back up."
item.skyabyss.wild_saltmill_maul.story: "The mill grinds salt; the salt grinds bone."
item.skyabyss.wild_blasting_axe.story: "The blast happens once. The axe, again and again."
item.skyabyss.wild_lampeater_hammer.stor: "The jaw that eats lamps spits out darkness."
item.skyabyss.wild_bonepipe_staff.story: "The bone pipe's note sinks to the abyss floor."
item.skyabyss.wild_salttear_staff.story: "Salt tears keep their shape when they dry."
item.skyabyss.wild_compass_staff.story: "The needle doesn't point north. It points home."
item.skyabyss.wild_mimic_heart_staff.sto: "What mimics a heartbeat wants to mimic a heart."
item.skyabyss.wild_saltcrow_bow.story: "Saltcrows collect shiny things. This bow collects lives."
item.skyabyss.wild_bonestring_bow.story: "A bone string makes no sound, so no one notices."
item.skyabyss.wild_lantern_bow.story: "A lantern arrow keeps lighting where it fell."
item.skyabyss.wild_ropecut_knife.story: "Cut the rope or guard it. The blade decides."
item.skyabyss.wild_bone_needle_dagger.st: "You notice the bone needle only after it's in."
item.skyabyss.wild_ceiling_claw.story: "Those who walk the ceiling come down from above."
item.skyabyss.wild_snuffer_dagger.story: "You snuff the lamp when you don't want to be seen."
item.skyabyss.wild_mourning_bell_staff.s: "The mourning bell rings in place of a name."
item.skyabyss.wild_saltpillar_totem.stor: "A salt pillar is the altar of those who looked back."
item.skyabyss.wild_knotted_bell_staff.st: "One knot for each who never came back."
item.skyabyss.wild_lullaby_bell_staff.st: "The abyss lullaby lulls you and never lets go."
item.skyabyss.wild_fulgurite_sword.story: "Where lightning strikes the ground, a sword remains."
item.skyabyss.wild_twin_spear.story: "Both heads of the twin spear face forward."
item.skyabyss.wild_chain_greatsword.stor: "Chains bind the things of the abyss. Even as a sword."
item.skyabyss.wild_meteor_greatsword.sto: "Iron fallen from the moon still remembers the sky."
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudcleaver_greatswo: "Cleave the clouds and there is a sea above them."
item.skyabyss.wild_molten_axe.story: "Molten iron takes any shape. It chose an axe."
item.skyabyss.wild_cog_hammer.story: "The cogs never stop. What they hit does."
item.skyabyss.wild_abyss_mace.story: "The deep swallows everything. This mace too."
item.skyabyss.wild_starforge_hammer.stor: "Strike in the star forge and the sparks become stars."
item.skyabyss.wild_skysplit_axe.story: "A blade to split the sky, one on either side."
item.skyabyss.wild_ballspark_staff.story: "Ball lightning rolls. Where it stops, it strikes."
item.skyabyss.wild_hourglass_staff.story: "Ash sand grows lighter each time it falls."
item.skyabyss.wild_deep_eye_staff.story: "The deep eye sees you before you see it."
item.skyabyss.wild_starchart_staff.story: "Stars missing from the chart are yet to be born."
item.skyabyss.wild_prism_staff.story: "At the rainbow's end there was a staff, not treasure."
item.skyabyss.wild_flash_bow.story: "After the flash, it's over before the sound arrives."
item.skyabyss.wild_scope_longbow.story: "If the spyglass can see it, the arrow can reach it."
item.skyabyss.wild_calling_bow.story: "Call and they answer. Shoot the one who answers."
item.skyabyss.wild_lighthouse_longbow.st: "A lighthouse arrow shines once for a lost ship."
item.skyabyss.wild_skylark_bow.story: "The skylark sings above the clouds; the arrow flies past them."
item.skyabyss.wild_spark_dagger.story: "When the two blades touch, sparks run."
item.skyabyss.wild_ash_sickle_claw.story: "An ash-covered sickle turns its harvest to ash."
item.skyabyss.wild_fishhook_knife.story: "The deep hook never lets go of its catch."
item.skyabyss.wild_mirror_dagger.story: "A wound seen in the mirror runs deeper than the real one."
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudveil_claw.story: "A claw hidden in cloud is gone when the sky clears."
item.skyabyss.wild_raincall_bell_staff.s: "Pray for rain and it falls even on the abyss floor."
item.skyabyss.wild_calming_censer.story: "The incense smoke calms the raging heart first."
item.skyabyss.wild_effigy_totem.story: "The doll takes your place. Whose, today?"
"The titans too hear the hymns above the clouds."
item.skyabyss.wild_guard_badge.story: "Whoever wears the bell badge fights in the capital's name."
item.skyabyss.wild_mossball_netsuke.stor: "The mossball lights its keeper's way home."
item.skyabyss.wild_herb_vial.story: "Herb medicine is bitter. Drink until it works."
item.skyabyss.wild_float_netsuke.story: "The glass float bobs, searching for the drowned."
item.skyabyss.wild_wolf_tooth_necklace.s: "A fang necklace keeps the wolf pack away."
item.skyabyss.wild_crab_backplate.story: "Leave your back to the shell and face forward."
item.skyabyss.wild_fog_handbell.story: "Ring the little bell and you can call names in the fog."
item.skyabyss.wild_weave_bracelet.story: "The cord is as thick as the wishes tied into it."
item.skyabyss.wild_emberbug_amber.story: "The bug in the amber is still warm."
item.skyabyss.wild_ramhorn_bugle.story: "Blow the horn and every ram on the ridge turns."
item.skyabyss.wild_ash_talisman.story: "An ash slip's wish arrives only once it burns."
item.skyabyss.wild_signal_fire.story: "Signal smoke passes the call for help from peak to peak."
item.skyabyss.wild_plumb_line_ring.story: "The plumb line keeps counting the abyss's depth."
item.skyabyss.wild_salttear_earring.stor: "The salt tear weeps softly by your ear."
item.skyabyss.wild_bonepipe_necklace.sto: "The bone pipe sounds against your chest unplayed."
item.skyabyss.wild_hangman_knot.story: "A knot that won't untie must not be untied."
item.skyabyss.wild_lamp_charm.story: "Even a small lamp takes one darkness from the abyss."
item.skyabyss.wild_mimic_heart_charm.sto: "The false heart beats harder than the real one."
item.skyabyss.wild_fulgurite_necklace.st: "Fulgurite is the shape of the lightning's path."
item.skyabyss.wild_ash_hourglass_charm.s: "Come back before the ash sand runs out."
item.skyabyss.wild_deep_eye_charm.story: "Let the deep eye keep watch and your back is safe."
item.skyabyss.wild_meteor_ring.story: "The meteoric ring leans toward the moon's pull."
item.skyabyss.wild_skylark_plume.story: "The skylark plume remembers the songs above the clouds."
item.skyabyss.wild_starchart_compass.sto: "The starchart needle points to unseen stars."
item.skyabyss.wild_moon_hourglass.story: "The lunar hourglass measures time in phases."
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudhymn_slip.story: "The hymn slip guards the pilgrim's road."
item.skyabyss.wild_oilskin_helmet.story: "The drip from the hood tastes of island rain."
item.skyabyss.wild_oilskin_chestplate.st: "An oiled coat sheds even the waves."
item.skyabyss.wild_oilskin_leggings.stor: "A fisher's legs keep going when soaked."
item.skyabyss.wild_oilskin_boots.story: "If the sea gets into your boots, turn back."
item.skyabyss.wild_belfry_helmet.story: "A bellringer guards the head before the ears."
item.skyabyss.wild_belfry_chestplate.sto: "The vestment's hem sways with each toll."
item.skyabyss.wild_belfry_leggings.story: "Belfry stairs are learned with the knees."
item.skyabyss.wild_belfry_boots.story: "The feet that pull the striker never leave the ground."
item.skyabyss.wild_oldsoldier_helmet.sto: "The dead soldier's helm still awaits the order."
item.skyabyss.wild_oldsoldier_chestplate: "Old plate weighs as much as its old wounds."
item.skyabyss.wild_oldsoldier_leggings.s: "Legs that never retreated still don't, as bones."
item.skyabyss.wild_oldsoldier_boots.stor: "Boots that trod the battlefield remember it."
item.skyabyss.wild_sailcloth_helmet.stor: "A sailcloth hood tells you where the sea wind blows."
item.skyabyss.wild_sailcloth_leggings.st: "Wrap your legs in canvas and the deck won't trip you."
item.skyabyss.wild_sailcloth_boots.story: "Shiomori shoes make no sound on sand."
item.skyabyss.wild_lurelight_helmet.stor: "The lamp on your head shows to fish and foe alike."
"A lurelight mantle stands out on the night sea."
item.skyabyss.wild_lurelight_leggings.st: "On the boat, even your legs carry light."
item.skyabyss.wild_ramfleece_helmet.stor: "A ramhorn helm calls a bolt for every horn."
"The fleece holds the thunder and stays warm."
item.skyabyss.wild_ramfleece_leggings.st: "Fleece greaves never slip, even on a cliff."
item.skyabyss.wild_ramfleece_boots.story: "Boots that follow hoofprints never lose the ridge."
item.skyabyss.wild_windweave_helmet.stor: "A Kazamachi headcloth turns toward the coming wind."
"Let the wind through the weave and the body grows light."
item.skyabyss.wild_windweave_leggings.st: "Legs that work the loom move to the wind's beat."
item.skyabyss.wild_windweave_boots.story: "Feet that wait for the wind never stop while waiting."
item.skyabyss.wild_ashleather_helmet.sto: "An ashleather helm fears no forge fire."
item.skyabyss.wild_ashleather_chestplate: "Haibaro leather grows tougher the more it burns."
item.skyabyss.wild_ashleather_leggings.s: "Legs that tread the ash forget the heat."
item.skyabyss.wild_ashleather_boots.stor: "Boots for burnt ground are real only once scorched."
item.skyabyss.wild_fortress_helmet.story: "The burnt fort's helm belonged to the last lookout."
item.skyabyss.wild_fortress_chestplate.s: "Heavy plate stands in for the fort's walls."
item.skyabyss.wild_fortress_leggings.sto: "The fort burned, but these legs held the gate."
item.skyabyss.wild_fortress_boots.story: "Boots that tread fallen stone do not waver."
item.skyabyss.wild_delver_helmet.story: "The delver's cap lamp counts the crew."
item.skyabyss.wild_delver_chestplate.sto: "Keep the rope for the way back in your work-coat pocket."
item.skyabyss.wild_delver_leggings.story: "Legs going down the ladder never look up."
item.skyabyss.wild_delver_boots.story: "Even at the bottom of the abyss, don't untie your boots."
item.skyabyss.wild_saltplate_helmet.stor: "A saltcrystal helm hardens as it drinks your sweat."
"Salt plate cleanses the wound as it guards."
item.skyabyss.wild_saltplate_leggings.st: "Salt greaves glitter in the damp layers."
item.skyabyss.wild_saltplate_boots.story: "The crunch of salt tells you the squad's pace."
item.skyabyss.wild_lampkeeper_helmet.sto: "A lampkeeper never lowers the hood beside a lamp."
item.skyabyss.wild_lampkeeper_chestplate: "Inside the vestment, one flame that never goes out."
item.skyabyss.wild_lampkeeper_leggings.s: "Legs that carry the lamp never run."
item.skyabyss.wild_lampkeeper_boots.stor: "A lampkeeper's footsteps push back the dark."
item.skyabyss.wild_hanged_helmet.story: "The hanged one's hood never looks up."
item.skyabyss.wild_hanged_chestplate.sto: "The shroud sways though there is no wind."
item.skyabyss.wild_hanged_leggings.story: "Legs wound in rope no longer seek the ground."
item.skyabyss.wild_copperwire_helmet.sto: "Lightning tips its hat to a copperwire helm."
item.skyabyss.wild_copperwire_chestplate: "The coiled copper sends the lightning to ground."
item.skyabyss.wild_copperwire_leggings.s: "Copper greaves lay a road for the lightning."
item.skyabyss.wild_soot_helmet.story: "A soot hood erases your face in the shadows."
item.skyabyss.wild_soot_chestplate.story: "The soot cloak matches the night of the ash layer."
item.skyabyss.wild_soot_boots.story: "Boots that tread soot swallow the sound."
item.skyabyss.wild_deepwarden_helmet.sto: "Inside the helm, the deepwarden never shuts an eye."
item.skyabyss.wild_deepwarden_chestplate: "The warden's breastplate bears the abyss's weight."
item.skyabyss.wild_deepwarden_leggings.s: "The deepwarden's legs keep no road for retreat."
item.skyabyss.wild_deepwarden_boots.stor: "The warden's boots never leave the post."
item.skyabyss.wild_stargazer_helmet.stor: "The stargazer's crown grows heavy on moonlit nights."
"The stars on the vestment match the real sky."
item.skyabyss.wild_stargazer_boots.story: "Boots on moon sand leave no prints."
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudknight_helmet.st: "Above the clouds, the knight sees no sky over the helm."
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudknight_chestplat: "The cloud plate turned white on the pilgrim road."
"Legs that tread the clouds don't know how to fall."
item.skyabyss.wild_cloudknight_boots.sto: "Cloud boots ring on the bridges of light."
